name: AAL-Bench
description: Scholarly PDFs contain metadata essential for building digital libraries. Although various tools and methods have been developed for extracting structured information from scholarly documents, existing evaluations largely assess the extraction of author names and affiliations independently, while resources for explicitly evaluating author–affiliation linking remain limited. We present a benchmark for this task, consisting of 507 manually annotated CC-BY arXiv papers. We evaluate several extraction tools and additionally analyze their performance across different document-class families. Our results show that GPT-5.6-sol achieved the best overall performance with rendered-page input, while the benefit of visual and layout information varied substantially across models and document-class families. The benchmark dataset is publicly available.
